title: Sheaf-level unit and composition comparison
statement: Let $R,S,T$ be schemes, $h:T\to S$, $f:S\to R$, $k:T\to R$, with $h\circ f=k$ in diagrammatic order, and let $G$ be a sheaf of sets on the small étale site of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $f^*,h^*,k^*$ for the constructed inverse images and $h_*$ for restriction along base change. Define $\beta(h,f,k):f^*G\to h_*k^*G$ to be the adjunction unit $f^*G\to h_*h^*f^*G$ followed by $h_*$ of the unique unit-compatible composition isomorphism $h^*f^*G\cong k^*G$ [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], transported along the given equality $h\circ f=k$. This definition has no unspecified data: the composition isomorphism is uniquely determined by its unit equation. Its value on a base-changed test object, followed by the canonical iterated-base-change restriction, is the section comparison of [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison].

def etaleSetSheafComparison
    {R S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ R) (k : T ⟶ R) (hk : h ≫ f = k)
    (G : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G ⟶
      ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (u + 1)) (S.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
        (T.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj G)
